subject: KMS/HSM evidence packet request — HarrowBank SIG/CAIQ review
content:
From: Julie White <julie.white@harrowbank.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@harrowbank.com
Date: Wed, 08 Nov 2028 13:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: KMS/HSM evidence for SIG/CAIQ — HarrowBank procurement

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this — HarrowBank is running a SIG/CAIQ review ahead of our procurement committee next week. We need a compact evidence packet focused on encryption and key management. Can you provide the following items (redacted where necessary) by EOD Friday?

- HSM vendor and current attestation (FIPS/CC/TAA) + date of last attestation (PDF preferred).
- Canonical KMS key policy and the policy that restricts admin access (JSON or text).
- Key rotation schedule and last rotation timestamps for tenant- and system-level keys.
- Sample CloudTrail (or equivalent) logs showing key creation/rotation/encrypt/decrypt for the last 30 days (redact customer IDs).
- Operator access matrix (who can rotate/unseal/unwrap keys) and a short description of RBAC model / separation-of-duties.
- BYOK / customer-managed key handshake artefact (if available) and proof of wrap/unwrap operations.
- Short answers to whether envelope encryption uses AES-GCM or AES-CBC, and whether DEK material is ever persisted unwrapped.

We will treat anything marked sensitive as strictly for the procurement review. If you prefer, a short link to a DocuSign acknowledgment for the attestation would be fine.

Appreciate a point-of-contact for follow-ups.

Best,
Julie White
Senior InfoSec Manager, HarrowBank
julie.white@harrowbank.com

Hi Julie — thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide everything you listed. I'm assembling a compact packet and will include the attestation PDF and a redacted CloudTrail extract.

Internal notes (cc'ing Laura and Marissa to pull artifacts):
- Laura: please pull the last 30 days of key activity from CloudTrail (redact tenant ids) and format as jsonl sample. Include operations: CreateKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, RotateKey, Encrypt, Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext.
- Marissa: can you export the operator access matrix and the canonical KMS key policy; also attach the rotation schedule and a CSV with last-rotation timestamps.

Julie — expected contents we will attach in the first delivery: hsm-attestation-202803.pdf, cloudtrail-key-activity-sample.jsonl (redacted), operator-access-matrix.xlsx, kms-rotation-schedule.csv, and a short FAQ answering the AES-GCM question and BYOK handshake notes. If you need a signed attestation, we can route via DocuSign — which I can initiate after you confirm.

Target: initial packet to you by EOD Thursday (I want to do a quick redaction pass). If procurement timeline is earlier, let me know and we will prioritize.

Thanks,

Rachel Kim

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Julie White <julie.white@harrowbank.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Nov 2028 16:20:45 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: KMS/HSM evidence for SIG/CAIQ — HarrowBank procurement

Rachel / Julie — attaching the files we discussed.

Attachments (stubs):
- hsm-attestation-202803.pdf (Thales Luna HSM — FIPS 140-2 level 3 attestation, vendor-signed, March 2028)
- cloudtrail-key-activity-sample.jsonl (redacted — contains single-line JSON events, timestamps in UTC; user identities and tenant ids redacted with <REDACTED_TENANT>)
- operator-access-matrix.xlsx (shows roles: infra-admin, sec-ops, site-reliability; which groups can perform unwrap/rotate/unseal)
- kms-rotation-schedule.csv (column: key_id, key_type, rotation_cadence_days, last_rotation_iso)

Quick answers inline to Julie's bullets:
- HSM vendor/attestation: Thales Luna Series X, FIPS 140-2 Level 3; last vendor attestation March 22, 2028; hardware rotation documented in attestation.
- Key policy: we enforce least privilege via IAM role-based policies plus a KMS wrapper that restricts Decrypt/GenerateDataKey to service principals; the canonical policy is included in operator-access-matrix.xlsx (sheet: KeyPolicies).
- Rotation: DEKs rotate per-tenant on a 30/90/365 cadence depending on data classification; system KEKs are rotated annually or upon operator-triggered events. CSV includes last_rotation_iso for each key family.
- CloudTrail sample: event examples include Encrypt/Decrypt with requestParameters.ciphertextBlob omitted; logs show principal ARN, eventTime, eventName, sourceIPAddress.
- BYOK: we support customer-wrapped KEKs via an RSA-OAEP1/sha256 wrapping policy; handshake uses ephemeral ECDH when requested; we include a short BYOK handshake note in the packet.
- Envelope encryption: DEKs are AES-256-GCM by default for tenant data. We do not persist DEKs in plaintext; DEKs are stored wrapped to the KEK and the plaintext DEK exists transiently in memory only during the operation.

Laura Bennett
Senior Crypto Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 09 Nov 2028 09:03:10 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: KMS/HSM evidence for SIG/CAIQ — HarrowBank procurement

Rachel / Laura — thanks, this is very helpful. A couple small follow-ups before I route to procurement:

1) Can the HSM attestation be signed and returned via DocuSign so our legal team has a signed copy? If so, initiate and loop me in.
2) For the CloudTrail sample: can you include a short readme describing which fields were redacted and the redaction method? Procurement wants assurance we didn't remove event context needed to understand access patterns.
3) Confirm that AES-256-GCM is used for tenant DEKs and that no plaintext DEK is written to persistent storage at any time (you already answered this, but procurement will want a one-line confirmation).
4) For BYOK: can you confirm the exact wrapping algorithm (RSA-OAEP-256 vs RSA-OAEP-1) and whether we support a hardware-originated key attestation from the customer's HSM?

If you can get those four items in the packet that's perfect. We appreciate the fast turnaround.

Thanks,
Julie
